title: [Dahuang Zhechong Pills delay heart aging by reducing cardiomyocyte apoptosis via PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha signaling pathway].
authors: Liu, Wen-Jie; Tu, Yue; He, Wei-Ming; Liu, Si-Yi; Pan, Liu-Yun-Xin; Wen, Kai-Zhi; Li, Cheng-Juan; Han, Chao
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药大黄蛰虫丸通过PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha通路延缓心脏衰老，仅用分子对接做初步预测，核心为细胞实验与信号通路验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to investigate the effect of Dahuang Zhechong Pills(DHZCP) in delaying heart aging(HA) and explore the potential mechanism. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to explore the targets and potential mechanisms of DHZCP in delaying HA. Furthermore, in vitro experiments were conducted with the DHZCP-containing serum to verify key targets and pathways in D-galactose(D-gal)-induced aging of cardiomyocytes. Active components of DHZCP were searched against the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform(TCSMP), and relevant targets were predicted. HA-related targets were screened from the GeneCards, Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man(OMIM), and DisGeNET. The common targets shared by the active components of DHZCP and HA were used to construct a protein-protein interaction network in STRING 12.0, and core targets were screened based on degree in Cytoscape 3.9.1. Metaspace was used for Gene Ontology(GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes(KEGG) enrichment analyses of the core targets to predict the mechanisms. Molecular docking was performed in AutoDock Vina. The results indicated that a total of 774 targets of the active components of DHZCP and 4 520 targets related to HA were screened out, including 510 common targets. Core targets included B-cell lymphoma 2(BCL-2), serine/threonine kinase 1(AKT1), and hypoxia-inducible factor 1 subunit A(HIF1A). The GO and KEGG enrichment analyses suggested that DHZCP mainly exerted its effects via the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase(PI3K)/AKT signaling pathway, HIF-1alpha signaling pathway, longevity signaling pathway, and apoptosis signaling pathway. Among the pathways predicted by GO and KEGG enrichment analyses, the PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha signaling pathway was selected for verification. The cell-counting kit 8(CCK-8) assay showed that D-gal significantly inhibited the proliferation of H9c2 cells, while DHZCP-containing serum increased the viability of H9c2 cells. SA-beta-gal staining revealed a significant increase in the number of blue-green positive cells in the D-gal group, which was reduced by DHZCP-containing serum. TUNEL staining showed that DHZCP-containing serum decreased the number of apoptotic cells. After treatment with DHZCP-containing serum, the protein levels of Klotho, BCL-2, p-PI3K/PI3K, p-AKT1/AKT1, and HIF-1alpha were up-regulated, while those of P21, P16, BCL-2 associated X protein(Bax), and cleaved caspase-3 were down-regulated. The results indicated that DHZCP delayed HA via multiple components, targets, and pathways. Specifically, DHZCP may delay HA by reducing apoptosis via activating the PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨大黄蛰虫丸（DHZCP）延缓心脏衰老（HA）的作用及其潜在机制。采用网络药理学和分子对接技术探索DHZCP延缓HA的靶点及潜在机制。此外，通过含DHZCP血清的体外实验，验证D-半乳糖（D-gal）诱导心肌细胞衰老中的关键靶点和通路。从传统中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（TCSMP）中检索DHZCP的活性成分，并预测相关靶点。从GeneCards、在线人类孟德尔遗传数据库（OMIM）和DisGeNET中筛选HA相关靶点。利用DHZCP活性成分与HA的共有靶点，在STRING 12.0中构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，并根据Cytoscape 3.9.1中的度值筛选核心靶点。使用Metaspace对核心靶点进行基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）富集分析，以预测机制。分子对接在AutoDock Vina中进行。结果表明，共筛选出DHZCP活性成分的774个靶点和4520个HA相关靶点，其中包括510个共有靶点。核心靶点包括B细胞淋巴瘤2（BCL-2）、丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶1（AKT1）和缺氧诱导因子1亚基A（HIF1A）。GO和KEGG富集分析提示，DHZCP主要通过磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（PI3K）/AKT信号通路、HIF-1α信号通路、长寿信号通路和凋亡信号通路发挥作用。在GO和KEGG富集分析预测的通路中，选择PI3K/AKT/HIF-1α信号通路进行验证。细胞计数试剂盒8（CCK-8）检测显示，D-gal显著抑制H9c2细胞增殖，而含DHZCP血清则提高H9c2细胞活力。SA-β-半乳糖苷酶染色显示，D-gal组蓝绿色阳性细胞数量显著增加，而含DHZCP血清可减少该数量。TUNEL染色显示，含DHZCP血清减少凋亡细胞数量。经含DHZCP血清处理后，Klotho、BCL-2、p-PI3K/PI3K、p-AKT1/AKT1和HIF-1α的蛋白水平上调，而P21、P16、BCL-2相关X蛋白（Bax）和裂解的caspase-3的蛋白水平下调。结果表明，DHZCP通过多成分、多靶点和多通路延缓HA。具体而言，DHZCP可能通过激活PI3K/AKT/HIF-1α信号通路减少凋亡，从而延缓HA。
